newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Coles seeks to exploit unused cost savings.
newsitem.headline: Coles seeks to exploit unused cost savings.

text.p: Retailer Coles Myer Ltd said on Monday the original merger of the Coles supermarket group and the Myer department store group in the mid-1980s had failed to cut the costs of shared back office functions.
But Coles chief executive Dennis Eck told reporters after a luncheon address that the group now aimed to exploit the as-yet unused cost savings that should have come from the merger.
Eck would not comment on the size of the potential cost savings.
"We are exploiting a failed merger," Eck said.
He said information systems, ordering systems and wholesaling could be better integrated to cut costs.
